access_review_cycles: A periodic access-review campaign; closes only when every review and resulting change is done (FR-RBAC-08).
access_reviews: One user's access reviewed by a reviewer within a cycle, with the outcome and notes.
accounting_periods: Periods 1-12 and the adjustment period 13 of a fiscal year, with status (FUTURE, OPEN, SOFT_CLOSED, CLOSED); sequence_key = year*100 + period.
alert_throttle: Operational alert throttle: at most one alert per key per quiet period; repeats are counted and reported with the next alert.
api_rate_windows: Cluster-wide API rate-limit counters in fixed one-minute windows (UNLOGGED, short-lived).
approval_decisions: Append-only log of every workflow decision (approve, return, reject, post) on vouchers and documents.
approval_limits: The most a holder of a role may approve on one document of a type; no values seeded (C-24).
approval_workflow_steps: Ordered steps of a journal-voucher approval workflow, with optional amount thresholds and the permission each step needs.
asset_categories: Fixed-asset classes with their asset, accumulated-depreciation and expense accounts and default useful life and residual rate (values are placeholders, C-30).
asset_disposals: Disposal of a fixed asset (sale, retirement), prepared and posted by different people.
asset_transfers: Transfer of an asset in service to another cost centre, location or custodian, with history; prepared and posted by different people.
auc_projects: Assets-under-construction projects accumulating cost before capitalisation.
audit_events: Append-only, hash-chained audit trail of business actions (who, what, when, actor roles, details).
bank_accounts: AVTECH's own bank accounts (last four digits only) linked to their cash-in-bank GL accounts.
bank_match_ledger_lines: Ledger lines belonging to a bank-reconciliation match.
bank_matches: A reconciliation match grouping bank statement lines with ledger lines of equal total.
bank_reconciliations: Bank reconciliation as of a date for one bank account, approved through the document workflow.
bank_statement_lines: Lines of an imported bank statement, matched or unmatched.
bank_statements: Imported bank statements (CSV or CAMT.053) with opening and closing balances.
billing_document_lines: Lines of a billing document (revenue account, cost centre, tax).
billing_documents: AR billing documents: invoices, credit memos and debit memos to customers.
budget_adjustments: Supplemental or realignment adjustments to an approved budget, decided by a second person.
budget_allocations: Allotment per budget-controlled account (and optionally cost centre) within a budget.
budget_reservations: Amounts reserved against an allocation by submitted documents; released or consumed on posting.
budgets: The Corporate Operating Budget of a fiscal year (one per year).
business_holidays: Holiday calendar for business-hours SLA clocks.
chart_of_accounts: Hierarchical chart of accounts with attributes (type, normal balance, postable, statement line, cost-centre and sub-ledger requirements, budget control, open-item management). Development uses COA's Revised Chart of Accounts for Government Corporations (2019); the former [PLACEHOLDER] PLC- accounts are inactive (C-22).
check_register: Issued cheques with number, payee, amount and status.
close_task_completions: A close task ticked off for one scope (day, period, quarter or year) with outcome and note.
close_tasks: Manual tasks of the close calendar per frequency, with the responsible permission and due offset ([PLACEHOLDER] seed, C-33).
currencies: Currencies; PHP is the single functional currency.
customer_contracts: Concessionaire contracts that drive recurring billing.
customers: Customers and concessionaires (AR master), each with a sub-ledger account.
deposits: Bank deposits of collections, posted by a second person.
depreciation_lines: Per-asset depreciation amounts of a run.
depreciation_runs: A depreciation run for one period, prepared and posted by different people.
disbursement_voucher_lines: Invoices and amounts paid by a disbursement voucher.
disbursement_vouchers: Disbursement vouchers (DVs) that pay supplier invoices, through approval, payment and posting.
document_contents: Stored bytes of supporting documents and other files (encrypted at rest since V35).
document_workflow_steps: Configurable approval steps for non-voucher documents (supplier invoices, DVs, billings, budgets, reconciliations).
fiscal_years: Fiscal years and their status (OPEN, CLOSED).
fixed_assets: The fixed-asset register: cost, residual value, useful life, location, custodian, cost centre and status.
gl_account_mappings: Configurable control accounts used by automatic postings (e.g. AP_TRADE_PAYABLE, INPUT_VAT, INVENTORY_REVALUATION).
gl_clearing_lines: Journal-entry lines in a clearing; a line is in at most one active clearing.
gl_clearings: A group of open items on an open-item managed account cleared together (manual, by reference or by amount); reversible.
gr_ir_matches: Supplier invoices charged to the GR/IR clearing account matched to goods receipts.
idempotency_keys: Stored responses for retried requests, per user, operation and key.
integration_attempts: Every attempt to send an integration transmission, with the response.
integration_transmissions: Outbound integration messages (BIR EIS sandbox adapter, bank files) with retries and status.
inventory_balances: Quantity on hand per item and warehouse.
inventory_documents: Goods receipts, issues, transfers, counts and price adjustments, reviewed and posted by a second person.
inventory_items: Stock items with their inventory and expense accounts.
inventory_movements: Immutable record of every quantity or value change of an item.
inventory_valuations: The weighted-average cost pool of an item (quantity and value across warehouses).
journal_entries: Posted, immutable journal entries (the general ledger).
journal_vouchers: Journal vouchers (JEVs) before posting: draft, in review and approval, posted, reversed, cancelled.
ledger_balances: Derived totals per account and period; rebuildable from the entries.
mfa_methods: Enrolled second factors (TOTP), with the secret encrypted and the last used time step.
migration_batch_rows: Every validated row of a migration batch, kept with its errors.
migration_batches: Opening-balance migration batches: one uploaded CAS-template CSV, validated, reconciled and applied by a second person.
notification_outbox: Outbound e-mail outbox written in the business transaction and dispatched asynchronously.
numbering_sequences: Gap-free official numbering per document type and fiscal year (row-locked counter).
organizations: The organisation (AVTECH) at the top of the structure.
parallel_run_lines: Per-account comparison lines of a parallel run, each difference with its explanation.
parallel_runs: Comparison of a legacy trial balance with CAS for one period, signed off by a second person.
password_reset_tokens: Password-reset tokens (SHA-256 hashes only), single use.
payment_batch_items: Payees and amounts in a payment-file batch.
payment_batches: ADA payment-file batches for electronic disbursements (file content encrypted).
period_status_changes: History of period opening, soft-closing, closing (with waived checks) and reopen requests and decisions.
permissions: The permission catalogue; `financial` marks permissions that authorise financial transactions.
portal_inquiries: Concessionaire inquiries and payment references submitted through the portal, and staff answers.
portal_link_requests: Requests to link a portal account to a customer, approved by a second person (C-18).
receipt_allocations: Allocation of a receipt to billing documents.
recurring_journal_lines: Lines of a recurring journal template.
recurring_journals: Templates that generate draft journal vouchers on a schedule.
refresh_tokens: Refresh tokens of a session (SHA-256 hashes only), rotated on every use.
report_jobs: Background report jobs with their parameters, status and generated file (encrypted).
report_schedules: Recurring report runs that queue ordinary report jobs for their owner.
report_templates: Versioned financial-statement templates, activated by a second person.
role_grant_requests: Maker-checker requests for role assignments carrying financial permissions (C-19).
roles: Roles (proposed matrix pending AVTECH sign-off, C-08).
security_events: Append-only, hash-chained security log (sign-ins, lockouts, MFA, permission changes) with severity.
sla_policies: Ticket SLA policies per contract phase, type and priority ([PLACEHOLDER] values, C-15).
sod_conflict_rules: Segregation-of-duties rules: pairs of permissions one user may not hold together (BLOCK) or that are flagged (WARN).
subsidiary_ledger_accounts: Subsidiary-ledger accounts (customers, suppliers, employees, other) used as a line dimension.
supplier_advances: Supplier advances outstanding at cutover (migrated); paying and liquidating them awaits C-31.
supplier_bank_accounts: Supplier bank accounts for electronic payment (account number encrypted), verified by a second person.
supplier_invoices: Supplier invoices (AP) with VAT and withholding, through approval and posting.
suppliers: Suppliers (AP master), each with a sub-ledger account.
supporting_documents: Attachments of any owner type (vouchers, invoices, DVs, billings, deposits, tickets, migration batches) with SHA-256 and scan status.
tax_codes: Tax codes (VAT, expanded withholding) with rates and accounts ([PLACEHOLDER] values pending BIR confirmation).
ticket_categories: Ticket categories maintained by TICKET_ADMIN ([PLACEHOLDER] seed, C-34).
ticket_events: Append-only history of a ticket (status changes, comments, internal notes, escalations, attachments).
tickets: Support tickets (incidents, service requests, change requests, enhancements) with SLA timers, severity, category and change control.
user_office_assignments: Effective-dated assignment of users to offices and departments.
user_sessions: One row per sign-in session; the access token carries its id.
users: User accounts (internal staff, concessionaire portal users, external auditors).
mfa_recovery_codes: Single-use recovery codes for a lost authenticator, stored as Argon2id hashes; spent or withdrawn rows are kept for audit.
mfa_email_codes: E-mailed one-time sign-in codes, bound to one sign-in step, stored as hashes, with attempts counted.
webauthn_credentials: Passkeys (WebAuthn credentials): public key, signature counter and flags per registered device.
webauthn_challenges: Single-use WebAuthn challenges for adding a passkey or signing in with one.
inventory_nrv_reviews: Lower of cost and market reviews: date, slow-moving threshold, status and the draft write-down proposed.
inventory_nrv_lines: Each item in a cost vs market review: quantity, cost, movement rate, coverage, market value and write-down.
allocation_cycles: Overhead allocation cycles (TOR B.7, B.8): code, name, status.
allocation_rules: A cycle's rules: sender account and cost centre, receiver account, key type.
allocation_receivers: Receiving cost centres of an allocation rule with their percentage or quantity.
allocation_runs: Each run of a cycle for a period and the draft journal voucher it created.
report_definitions: Saved ad hoc reports: dataset, columns, filters, grouping and order; owner and whether shared.
interface_batches: Inbound payroll, FMIS budget and asset files: format, SHA-256, parsed rows, problems found, who sent and decided them, and the drafts created.
api_clients: Systems allowed to read CAS through the API (OAuth 2.0 client credentials): client id, read scopes, Argon2id secret hash, status and use.
webhook_subscriptions: Receivers told about events (posting, approval, payment): HTTPS URL, events, encrypted signing secret, status and failures.
webhook_deliveries: Each event sent to each subscription: payload, attempts, next attempt, last result.
webhook_cursor: How far the webhook dispatcher has read the audit trail.
legal_holds: Legal holds on a fiscal year's records (or all records): reason, reference, who placed and released them, and why.
data_exports: Full data exports for AVTECH (TOR §3.6): purpose, requester and a different approver, status, and the encrypted file's name, size and SHA-256.
anomaly_findings: Suspicious-activity findings from the anomaly rules, each recorded once by fingerprint, with the independent review.
